title: The diagonal of an algebraic space is locally of finite type, a monomorphism, separated and locally quasi-finite
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for an algebraic space F over S with diagonal Delta : F -> F x F, the diagonal is locally of finite type, a monomorphism, separated and locally quasi-finite (source lines 2296-2308). The proof uses a presentation F = U/R and the cartesian square relating Delta to j : R -> U x_S U, which by the transfer lemma for representable morphisms reduces the four assertions to the corresponding properties of j; these follow because j is a monomorphism (an equivalence relation), hence separated, while the etale projections make j locally of finite type and its finite fibres make it locally quasi-finite.
